name: GreenLeaf Pharmacy
services: Blood pressure and blood sugar checks

delivery.notes: Same day delivery for orders placed before 5 PM. Cold chain items are delivered in an insulated box.

policies.prescription: Prescription-only medicines need a valid prescription. You can send a photo of it ahead of pickup.
policies.returns: Unopened non-refrigerated items can be returned within 7 days with the receipt.
policies.insurance: We accept most major insurance plans. Bring your card at pickup.
policies.clinical_advice: Dosage, drug interaction and diagnosis questions are always transferred to the pharmacist on duty.

faqs.question: Do you deliver?
faqs.answer: Yes, we deliver free within 5 miles for orders over 2125 rupees, and same day if you order before 5 PM.

faqs.question: Can I get a medicine without a prescription?
faqs.answer: Over the counter items yes. Prescription-only medicines need a valid prescription before we can dispense them.

faqs.question: Can you hold an item for me?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can reserve stock at the counter for up to 24 hours under your name and phone number.
